-- Dimensions:
--   activities.surface_or_unknown (decoupling_calc->activities)
-- Metrics:
--   decoupling_calc.avg_decoupling
--   decoupling_calc.long_run_count
SELECT
  CASE
  WHEN ("activities"."run_surface" IS NULL) THEN 'unknown'
  ELSE "activities"."run_surface"
  END AS "run_surface",
  AVG("decoupling_calc"."decoupling_pct") AS "avg_decoupling",
  COUNT("decoupling_calc"."activity_id") AS "long_runs"
FROM
  decoupling_calc "decoupling_calc"
  LEFT JOIN activities "activities" ON "decoupling_calc"."activity_id" = "activities"."id"
WHERE
  (CAST ( "decoupling_calc"."activity_start" AS timestamptz ) >= CAST ( '2026-07-24T00:00:00.000+02:00' AS timestamptz )) AND
  (CAST ( "decoupling_calc"."activity_start" AS timestamptz ) < CAST ( '2026-10-22T00:00:00.000+02:00' AS timestamptz ))
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  AVG("decoupling_calc"."decoupling_pct") DESC
